name: Agentic Safety Supervisor
purpose: The LangGraph cognitive layer: a multi-turn ReAct supervisor with six domain tools, a multi-provider LLM factory with a deterministic offline reasoner, Pipeline 1 (permits-to-work -> BIM exclusion envelopes) and Pipeline 2 (multimodal incident adjudication + active-learning curation).

public_interfaces.name: build_supervisor_agent (6 tools)
public_interfaces.contract: Multi-turn ReAct loop returning an answer plus the executed tool trace; every tool returns real repository state and never a placeholder.

public_interfaces.name: get_agent_llm factory
public_interfaces.contract: OpenAI/Anthropic when explicitly configured, DeterministicAgentLLM as the offline fallback; air-gapped operation must not require network access.

public_interfaces.name: Pipeline 1 compile_manifest / Pipeline 2 adjudicate
public_interfaces.contract: Pipeline 1 persists a validated ShiftSafetyManifest and pushes envelopes to the edge runtime; Pipeline 2 persists a forensic incident record and curates edge cases into the active-learning queue.

coupling_exceptions.reason: Pipeline 1 reads the live SentinelEdgeRuntime instance that the API module currently holds as module-level state.
coupling_exceptions.resolution: Move the runtime registry into a small accessor module owned by edge-runtime (or inject the runtime into build_context_pipeline) and delete the src.api import.

coupling_exceptions.reason: The telemetry tool reads the same module-level runtime/demo state owned by the gateway.
coupling_exceptions.resolution: Consume a narrow telemetry-provider protocol passed into build_supervisor_agent instead of importing the API module.

coupling_exceptions.reason: The supervisor's scenario/telemetry tool reaches directly into DemoService owned by the gateway.
coupling_exceptions.resolution: Provide a telemetry port (protocol + adapter registered by the gateway) and remove the concrete import.

acceptance_criteria: The supervisor answers a telemetry question offline with DeterministicAgentLLM and a visible tool trace.
Pipeline 1 rejects invalid permit text with a validation error instead of writing a manifest.
Pipeline 2 writes an incident record and appends to the active-learning queue exactly once per event.
After the coupling debt is paid, this project imports no src.api module.
risks: Three documented coupling exceptions currently make this project and api-gateway mutually dependent; the dependency graph is acyclic only because the debt is declared rather than fixed.
Production LLM behaviour depends on an external provider; the deterministic path is the only one that can be verified offline.
